evidence: Absent from the official REST reference for repositories (https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/repos, fetched 2026-09-23): the only documented single-repository GET is GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}.

Absent from GitHub's official OpenAPI description (github/rest-api-description, descriptions/api.github.com/api.github.com.json, openapi 3.0.3, info.version 1.1.4, fetched 2026-09-23): no /repositories/{repository_id} path exists.

GitHub staff (community discussion https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/24515) confirm the API can resolve a repository by database ID, and decline to say if or when it becomes official and documented.
The installed official gh 2.93.0 binary uses repositories/%d only for sub-resources (codespaces, environment variables), never the bare route.
capability_findings.consequence: Per the owner's ENDPOINT RULE and the documentation standard, DE_FACTO_UNDOCUMENTED does not become governed authority automatically.

capability_findings.route: B. GraphQL keyed by a repository identifier
evidence: GitHub's official public GraphQL schema (https://docs.github.com/public/fpt/schema.docs.graphql, fetched 2026-09-23): the Query root offers repository(owner: String!, name: String!) (name-keyed, prohibited), node(id: ID!) / nodes(ids: [ID!]!) (global node IDs), repositoryOwner(login:) and resource(url:). No Query field takes a numeric databaseId.

GitHub's global node ID guide (https://docs.github.com/en/graphql/guides/migrating-graphql-global-node-ids) directs integrators to treat node IDs as opaque strings; deriving one from a numeric repoId would be an undocumented transformation, which the owner decision excludes.

capability_findings.route: C. Other official numeric repository_id routes
evidence: Every path in the official OpenAPI description that takes {repository_id} is a PUT or DELETE (e.g. adding or removing a repository from an organization secret, variable, runner group or app installation). All are mutations; none returns repository identity.
GET /repos/{owner}/{repo} with Vercel's untrusted link.org / link.repo as input (sends the untrusted name).
